M002.label: favourable
M002.quote: The disposition of Venus — free as it is from any malefic association — accounts for the complete absence of passions and sensual feelings even towards his own wife
M002.note: Raman presents total absence of sexual passion as a virtue of a saint; whether that counts as favourable 'virility' is debatable.

M010.label: favourable
M010.quote: Ultimate triumph of the Divine is evident in view of the disposition of the Moon, Jupiter and Venus in Dharmatrikonas.
M010.note: Self summed up through character, poetic genius and spiritual attainment; no health verdict.

M018.label: favourable
M018.quote: Mercury in the 10th in the constellation of Mars has given her considerable reputation as an exponent and teacher of Yoga.
M018.note: Native is a woman; career and reputation came in Mercury Dasa.

M026.label: afflicted
M026.quote: This weakens the 12th house and gives wasteful expenditure. The native took delight in horse-racing in which he lost sometimes.
M026.note: Jupiter in the 12th kept his reputation untarnished, but the expenditure verdict is negative.

M034.label: none
M034.note: Only records the 1901 marriage to Mileva and its timing; no verdict on the marriage or wife.

M042.label: afflicted
M042.quote: gave the native two marriages, the second occurring after the death of the first husband.
M042.note: Native is female; first husband died.

M050.label: afflicted
M050.quote: Bandhana yogas or combinations for incarceration causing great suffering.
M050.note: Imprisoned 1897, later transported for life and held at Mandalay.

M058.label: favourable
M058.quote: The native of Chart No. 105 first went abroad in the Sun's Dasa, Jupiter's Bhukti.
M058.note: Foreign travel and continuing residence abroad are promised and came about.

M066.label: afflicted
M066.quote: This horoscope belongs to a gentleman, once an aristocrat, but now reduced to poverty, debts and mental torture.
M066.note: 'Once an aristocrat' is inherited background; Raman's own judgment of the Dhana Lagna is wholly adverse.

M074.label: favourable
M074.quote: Henry Ford as every one knows was a great industrialist, engineer and manufacturer of automobiles besides being one of the richest, if not the richest man in the world.

M082.label: mixed
M082.quote: These combinations no doubt gave him a robust constitution but the planet of vitality being eclipsed by Rahu rendered him ruin his health through overwork.
M082.note: Two-sided: robust constitution, but health ruined by overwork.

M090.label: afflicted
M090.quote: But Saturn and Rahu, lending their influences, have sapped up all the vitality so that he brought ruin not only upon himself but also to his country.

M098.label: favourable
M098.quote: The native acquired immense properties as heir to an erstwhile prince in Jupiter's Dasa, Jupiter's Bhukti.

M106.label: favourable
M106.quote: conferred on Sankara a magnificent intellect, penetrative mind and lofty character.
M106.note: Raman separately gives Alpayu (short life) from the 8th lord, but the Lagna and self verdict is strongly positive.

M114.label: favourable
M114.quote: Sir Ashutosh owed a good deal of his mental peculiarities and gifts to the educative influence of his father during the formative days of his youth
M114.note: Father died in 1889 when the native was about 25; Raman only times that event and does not call it early.

M122.label: none
M122.note: No verdict on Truman's father anywhere in the entry; 'reached power through a death' is about the presidency.

M130.label: favourable
M130.quote: Roosevelt lived the life of a young man of independent means
M130.note: Raman notes Rajayogas in the 11th ('gains and consolidation', line 10216) but never states a clear verdict on income.

M138.label: favourable
M138.quote: the subject was a professor. Jupiter's strong disposition has rendered the native an authority on Power-Engineering.

M146.label: favourable
M146.quote: the third lord and Mars are well disposed with the result the native is blessed with a number of brothers and sisters.

M154.label: favourable
M154.quote: the exaltation of the 10th lord Jupiter in a spiritual sign aspected by the 12th lord Venus which has made the native a Karmayogi-cum-Jnani.
M154.note: Also took to celibacy voluntarily; the spiritual outcome is the moksha reading.

M162.label: favourable
M162.quote: The Kahala Yoga was also responsible for his becoming the poet-laureate.

M170.label: none
M170.note: Raman limits himself to 'certain relevant Bhavas'; the 4th appears only as intellect within the parivarthana, with no verdict on happiness.

M178.label: afflicted
M178.quote: The natives' general education in the sense of school knowledge is poor. His knowledge of English is almost nil.
M178.note: Not in the Chart 121 window; same birth data as Chart 82 (16-3-1908 10:56), found at line 4892. Raman adds that he self-studied and has a unique grasp of politics, so it could be read as mixed, but by Raman's own definition at line 4865 his education is poor.

M186.label: afflicted
M186.quote: The 8th houses and 8th lords both from Lagna and the Moon are heavily afflicted by Saturn-Mars influences. It is believed the native committed suicide

M194.label: favourable
M194.quote: Rahu's position in the 6th from Lagna is favoured as it indicates success over enemies.
M194.note: Raman says separately that he was not robust in youth (line 8704), but on the 6th house and enemies the verdict is positive.

M202.label: favourable
M202.quote: This is a unique combination indicative of great influence, wealth and power, all of which he wielded not for personal gain or pomp
M202.note: The wealth belongs to the pontifical seat he held.

M210.label: favourable
M210.quote: enabling the native to be raised to the lofty responsibility and position of Pope — the religious head of millions of catholics throughout the world.

M218.label: afflicted
M218.quote: The native spent fabulous sums on his private life.
M218.note: Extravagant spending on wives and mistresses.

M226.label: favourable
M226.quote: in turn aspected by 11th lord Mercury resulted in fabulous gains to the native.

M234.label: afflicted
M234.quote: Note the Powerful afflictions to the lord of the 7th and Venus — the Kalatrakaraka. He is a bachelor.

M242.label: afflicted
M242.quote: The native initially suffered from night-blindness and later lost his vision completely.

M250.label: afflicted
M250.quote: On account of all these combinations, the native lost his eye-sight in the suh-period of Rahu within the major period of Jupiter.

M258.label: afflicted
M258.quote: More than anything else the heavy affliction to Venus both in Rasi and Navamsa was responsible for making the native totally blind.
M258.note: Chart 252 is Milton; the conclusion is split across a page break.

M266.label: afflicted
M266.quote: The native was a President of the United States of America and was shot dead on 22-11-1963. The 8th house, 8th lords both from Lagna and Moon are considerably afflicted by malefics.

M274.label: afflicted
M274.quote: the papakartari to the 11th house does not augur well for elder co-borns.
M274.note: Two-sided outcome: an elder sister survives, an elder brother died (line 14835). Raman's own verdict is adverse. The cited II:1638-1680 is the same birth as Chart 12, a 7th-house reading.

M282.label: afflicted
M282.quote: resulted in the early death of father in September 1877.
M282.note: The father died the same year the native was born.

M290.label: afflicted
M290.quote: The position of Rahu in the 9th indicates early death to his father.

M298.label: mixed
M298.quote: The mother lived till the 36th year of the native on account of the general strength of the fourth house and fourth lord. The Matru-Karaka Moon, who is the primary indicator of the mother, is considerably afflicted.
M298.note: Weighed both ways: the mother lived moderately long, but the karaka is afflicted.

M306.label: afflicted
M306.quote: Houses of finance (2nd), fortune (9th) and profession (10th) have all been afflicted in some way or other.
M306.note: Brilliant writer, but 'misfortune dogged him' and he ended in suicide.

M314.label: afflicted
M314.quote: Though the third house is somewhat favourable, as the lord cum the Karaka is severely afflicted, the subject has no brothers.
